name: lying (prone) abdominal stretch
description: A face-down stretch that lengthens the abdominals, similar to a cobra position.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up slowly, straightening your arms as far as is comfortable.
Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes.
Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower down.
